verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a REST API (docs-11, docs-24, docs-49) and an MCP server for agent tooling (docs-22/31/33/44, probe-3), but there is no mention anywhere of official client SDKs (e.g., Python, JS, Ruby libraries) for developers to build against, and a probe for an OpenAPI spec returned 404s (rootly-probe-2), suggesting no formal SDK-generation artifact either.
